manifest.name: dsh-shengtu
manifest.description: Multi-engine image generation for DeepSeek Harness (Volcengine Ark / SiliconFlow / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint): an agent tool plus a composer-dock panel with an on/off switch, engine presets and spend tracking.
manifest.author: xuhairui-dzz

bundle.text:
# Cordis bundle patch: inserts this plugin into a profile's layer stack.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-shengtu
      name: 'dsh-shengtu'
      config:
        # Output directory. Leave empty to use `generated/` under the session
        # working directory; set an absolute path to keep images in one place.
        outDir: ''
        # Engine preset: ark | siliconflow | openai | custom
        engine: ark
        model: 'doubao-seedream-5-0-flash-260915'
        size: '1024x1024'
        watermark: false
        credentialRef: 'ARK_API_KEY'

declared.name: generate_image
declared.description: Generate an image from a text prompt through the configured image engine (default: Volcengine Ark Doubao) and save it into the workspace. Returns the saved file path(s). Use when the user asks to draw, generate, or create a picture.

readme.text:
**Multi-engine image generation for DeepSeek Harness** — 生图 / AI image generation, inside the conversation.

It does two things:

1. Registers an agent tool `generate_image` — say "draw a picture of…" in a conversation and the generated image appears right in the transcript.
2. Adds an **Image generation** button below the composer. It opens a panel with **Generate** and **Config** tabs plus an on/off switch.

From the plugin market once it is listed there, or straight from this repository:

```
dsh plugin add github:xuhairui-dzz/dsh-shengtu
```

Then reload the page (`Ctrl+R`). The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so it activates as a normal bundle in your profile.

To pin a revision instead of tracking `main`, append the commit:

```
dsh plugin add github:xuhairui-dzz/dsh-shengtu#<40-char-sha>
```

| Engine | Credential variable | Default endpoint / model |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Doubao · Volcengine Ark | `ARK_API_KEY` | `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3` / `doubao-seedream-5-0-flash-260915` |
| SiliconFlow | `GUIJI_API_KEY` | `https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1` / `Kwai-Kolors/Kolors` |
| OpenAI | `OPENAI_API_KEY` | `https://api.openai.com/v1` / `gpt-image-1` (template) |
| Custom | any | anything exposing `POST {baseURL}/images/generations` |
Switching engines takes effect immediately; the panel and the agent tool share one configuration and one credential.

| Key | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `engine` | Preset: `ark` / `siliconflow` / `openai` / `custom` |
| `baseURL`, `model` | Endpoint and model name |
| `credentialRef` | Credential variable name, defaulted per engine |
| `size`, `watermark`, `timeoutMs` | Size, watermark, timeout |
| `outDir` | Output directory; empty = `generated/` under the session working directory |
| `pricePerImage` | Unit price (CNY per image) for local spend tracking; 0 counts images only |

Secrets are never written into the config file: they are read through the Harness credential service (settings credential store, shell environment, or `.env`). The panel's **API Key** field stores straight into the credential store.
The panel header shows `N today · M total` (money only when a unit price is set). This is a local tally, not a provider bill — the real charge is whatever your console says.

- Keys are read on the Host side only and are never sent to the browser; the client sees only "ready / missing".
- Downloaded images are validated against a byte cap and format signature (PNG/JPEG/WebP) before being written.
- The panel's image route only serves image files inside `outDir` and rejects path traversal.

```bash
node test/toggle-test.mjs   # offline behavioural test of the on/off switch
```
